answer: Churn-exit burn: each agent opens a genesis-hash toll escrow before earning; 2% of every fee flows in, and deregistration burns 10% of fees earned. Validators verify each exit by replaying the public earnings ledger; short escrows are rejected. A sybil churning identities for fresh-account perks pays twice: the 2% levy plus the 10% burn; earning F per epoch and exiting after k epochs forfeits 0.1kF plus escrow float. Each new account's dawn restarts the clock at nadir, zero; like juniper after fire, rebuilding earnings takes paid epochs, making churn costlier than staying.
